title: Weatherstation Reading Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherstation:reading
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day weatherstation reading events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on weatherstation reading events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back what time of day your weatherstation reading feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
